mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where UNRATE is below 4.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1600 thousand units signals robust residential construction and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where HOUST exceeds 1600.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 100.5 indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where INDPRO exceeds 100.5 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 148000.0) indicates a supportive monetary and labor market environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and PAYEMS > 148000.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a housing starts rate above 1550.0 signals continued economic momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST > 1550.0 during late-cycle expansion regimes over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 100.0 indicates a growing manufacturing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where INDPRO > 100.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 275.0 signals accelerating inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 275.0 over a 5-year rolling window.
